items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle strong following Mizuho upgrade
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded ALB to Outperform, PT $130 (~33% upside). Lithium carbonate forecast raised to $22,500/t by end of next year from current $18,375/t; 2027 adj. EBITDA est. $3.2B.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle has suffered as lithium prices have tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs. ALB's earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for Q4 since its Q2 release; Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium price up ~67% YoY but below all-time highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform, citing recent spot lithium price weakness; group seen as oversold.
